notes[archived-status-superset]: GET /tasks?status=archived was rejected at validation because QueryTasksDto restated six of the seven statuses the shared list declares. The fix imports TASK_STATUSES instead of restating it. Measured consequence: the accepted set is a strict SUPERSET of the previous one — all six former values still validate with 0 errors, archived newly validates, and a value in neither list is still refused (3/3, executed against the DTO). No existing caller changes behaviour, so the contract diff's TYPE_CHANGED enum->ref is breaking in shape and not in behaviour. That is the basis of every exemption carrying this ref.
